title: 第十七章 暴雨中的炎帝二 T第十八章 终到正辉灯塔
content_zh:
“碰！”的一声，注意力被班吉拉和快龙吸引住的炎帝被卡咪龟的水泡直接命中，虽然等级相差很大，但炎帝也受了不小的伤，被水泡推出撞到两根大树才停下来。
暴雨天气对火系小精灵影响很大，更别说别水系大招直接命中。
“嗷！”
炎帝从地上爬起，怒吼着瞪着卡咪龟，而它起来的地方已经变成了一片焦黑。卡咪龟毫不胆胆怯的和炎帝对视，虽然它打不过炎帝，可也知道在班吉拉和快龙倒下之前炎帝不可能攻击到自己。
“班！！！”
班吉拉一直把卡咪龟当成小弟，怎么能容忍自己的小弟受欺负，为了维护自己老大的地位班吉拉朝炎帝冲去，狰狞的大嘴闪着银光，向炎帝咬去。
班吉拉用冰牙攻击炎帝，炎帝也毫不示弱的使用火焰车对着班吉拉冲来，快龙和卡咪龟这时候并没有出手，静静的站在一旁，林萧也没有吭声，这场战斗已经演变成了尊严之战，容不得他人插手。要是林萧现在选择自己指挥班吉拉，事后班吉拉恐怕会有怨言，换成快龙和卡咪龟出手的话，班吉拉绝对会舍下炎帝，对它们发动进攻。
双方的攻击都命中了对方，班吉拉的胸口冒起了黑烟，盔甲被烧糊了一大块，炎帝也好不到哪去，班吉拉的冰牙咬中它的后颈。
在这种时候班吉拉体型和力量的优势就体现了出来，班吉拉只是微微退后了几步，炎帝却被撞飞出去几米远。
暴雨天对炎帝影响很大，班吉拉同样如此，沙暴特性无法使用。力量占优势的班吉拉紧随其后一记岩石切割打在炎帝身上，连接受创的炎帝被打倒在地剧烈喘息着，身上的火焰和背部的浓烟消散了不少。
两只同样为成都地区的小精灵凝望着对方，只不过一个是准神，一个是次神罢了，说起来不论是三圣兽、三神鸟、三神柱都很悲催，身为神兽种数值还没有班吉拉、快龙、暴地龙这些准神高。
“碰！”
炎帝和班吉拉相撞在一起展开了肉搏，虽然有着各自的属性和技能，但小精灵很多时候内心和野兽一样喜欢打肉搏战，但发生的次数也不多，神奇百倍联盟对这方面的记载只有寥寥几笔。
肉搏战斗，身高2米，体长3.5米，重量200公斤的炎帝对上林萧的班吉拉只有吃亏的命，班吉拉的每一次重拳都能将炎帝击飞几米远，炎帝的爪子和牙齿却只能在班吉拉的盔甲上留下一点伤痕。
最终，在班吉拉的一次甩尾下，炎帝耗尽了自己的体力，战败了。
“班！！！！”
班吉拉怒吼着拍打自己的胸口，丝毫不顾身上的伤，仰起头对着天空咆哮。
几分钟过后，班吉拉普通一声坐倒在地上，喘着粗气。和炎帝的战斗消耗了它大量的体力，盔甲上烧焦和留血的伤口，不断刺激它的神经。
为班吉拉和炎帝处理好伤口后，林萧掏出在小精灵学院打劫而来的大师球收服炎帝。
大师球收服小精灵的几率是百分之百，超神兽除外，超梦、凤王、裂空座等这些实力变态的小精灵已经不是精灵球能束缚的了，除非它们自己愿意，否则小小的精灵球对它们来说可有可无。

收好精灵球，林萧拖着满是泥巴的湿衣服，朝帐篷慢慢挪去，因为根本走不快，天黑、路滑、还稀里哗啦的下着雨，至于手电筒在收服炎帝的时候太激动，不知扔哪去了。
许久，林萧终于看大了自己的帐篷，帐篷中的节能灯光，让他松了口气，短短十几分钟，林萧就摔了三个跟头，还好没碰到石头，不然有得受的。
林萧才靠近帐篷，一道jiaoxiao的身影就扑到他怀里。
content_en:
With a sound of "Bump!", Emperor Yan, whose attention was attracted by Bangila and Kuailong, was directly hit by the bubble of Cammy Turtle. Although the level difference was very big, Emperor Yan also suffered a lot of injuries. He was pushed out by the bubble and hit two big trees before he stopped.
Heavy rain has a great impact on fire-type elves, not to mention direct hits from water-type ultimate moves.
"Ouch!"
Emperor Yan got up from the ground, roaring and glaring at the Cammy Turtle, and the place where it got up had turned into a scorched black place. Cammy Turtle looked at Yan Emperor without timidity. Although it could not defeat Yan Emperor, it also knew that Yan Emperor could not attack him before Bangila and Kuailong fell.
"Ban!!!"
Bangira has always regarded Cammy Turtle as his younger brother, how could he tolerate his younger brother being bullied? In order to protect his position as the boss, Bangira rushed towards Emperor Yan, and bit into Emperor Yan with his ferocious big mouth shining with silver light.
Bangila used ice teeth to attack Yandi, and Yandi showed no signs of weakness and used a flame car to rush towards Bangila. Kuailong and Cammy Turtle did not take action at this time, and stood quietly aside. Lin Xiao did not say a word. This battle has evolved into a battle of dignity, and no one else is allowed to intervene. If Lin Xiao chooses to command Bangira now, Bangira may complain afterwards. If it were Kuailong and Cammy Turtle who take action, Bangira will definitely abandon Yandi and launch an attack on them.
Both sides' attacks hit each other. Black smoke rose from Bangira's chest, and a large piece of his armor was burned. Emperor Yan was not much better, as Bangira's ice teeth bit its back neck.
At this time, Bangira's advantages in size and strength were revealed. Bangira only took a few steps back slightly, but Emperor Yan was knocked away a few meters away.
Heavy rainy days have a great impact on Yandi, and the same is true for Banjira. The sandstorm feature cannot be used. Bangila, who had the upper hand in strength, then hit Yandi with a rock cut. The injured Yandi was knocked to the ground and panted violently. The flames on his body and the smoke on his back dissipated a lot.
Two elves from the Chengdu area stared at each other, but one was a quasi-god and the other was a sub-god. Speaking of which, the three sacred beasts, the three sacred birds, and the three sacred pillars were all very sad. As divine beasts, their numerical values ​​were not as high as those of the quasi-gods such as Bangira, Kuailosaurus, and Tyrannosaurus.
"Touch!"
Yandi and Bangila collided and started fighting hand-to-hand. Although they had their own attributes and skills, the elf often liked hand-to-hand fighting as much as the beast in his heart, but it didn't happen often. There were only a few records of this aspect in the Magic Hundred Times Alliance.
In hand-to-hand combat, Yandi, who is 2 meters tall, 3.5 meters long and weighs 200 kilograms, will only suffer a loss against Lin Xiao's Bangila. Each of Bangila's punches can knock Yandi away several meters, but Yandi's claws and teeth can only leave a little scar on Bangila's armor.
In the end, under a flick from Bangira, Emperor Yan exhausted his energy and was defeated.
"Ban!!!"
Bangila roared and slapped his chest, regardless of the injuries on his body, raised his head and roared at the sky.
A few minutes later, Banjira sat down on the ground with a sound, breathing heavily. The battle with Emperor Yan consumed a lot of its physical strength, and the burnt and bloody wounds on its armor constantly irritated its nerves.
After treating the wounds of Bangila and Emperor Yan, Lin Xiao took out the master ball that he had robbed from the Elf Academy to conquer Emperor Yan.
The master ball has a 100% chance of conquering the elf, except for the super beasts. The elf with abnormal strength, such as Mewtwo, Ho-oh, Rayquaza, etc., can no longer be restrained by the elf ball. Unless they are willing, the small elf ball is dispensable to them.
After putting away the Poke Ball, Lin Xiao dragged his wet clothes full of mud and slowly moved towards the tent, because he couldn't walk fast at all, it was dark, the road was slippery, and it was raining lightly. As for the flashlight, he was so excited when he conquered Yan Emperor that he didn't know where he threw it.After a long time, Lin Xiao finally looked at his tent. The energy-saving lights in the tent made him relieved. In just ten minutes, Lin Xiao fell three times. Fortunately, he didn't hit any rocks, otherwise he would have been able to bear it.
Just as Lin Xiao approached the tent, a jiaoxiao figure threw herself into his arms.
